recent_videos.title: SpaceX's $2T Case, Nvidia's Shock Selloff, America Turns on AI, Trump Pulls AI Order, Bond Crisis?
recent_videos.thesis: The AI economy is simultaneously generating unprecedented value (Anthropic profitable, SpaceX's $45B Anthropic deal, NVIDIA at $5.3T) while triggering a PR and social crisis driven by dystopian layoff messaging, anti-humanist perception, and possible foreign information campaigns — and the macro backdrop of 310% global debt-to-GDP and rising yields adds a second storm.

recent_videos.title: Elon's Anthropic Deal, The Next AI Monopoly?, "FDA for AI" Panic, Trading the AI Boom
recent_videos.thesis: Anthropic just outran every comparable: $10B → $44B ARR in four months, with the only constraint being compute and power. The SpaceX-Anthropic deal solves that for both sides simultaneously, sets up SpaceX's IPO as a Mag-1 candidate, and shifts the AI story from 'will the revenue show up?' to 'is one company about to become the most powerful monopoly in human history?' Meanwhile the regulatory and PR backlash is building faster than the industry's response to it.

recent_videos.title: Yann LeCun's $1B Bet Against LLMs
recent_videos.thesis: LeCun argues that LLMs are a dead-end for general intelligence and that JEPA — a non-generative, joint-embedding world-model architecture — is the right substrate for agents that can predict the consequences of their actions.

recent_videos.title: Jensen Huang – Will Nvidia's moat persist?
recent_videos.thesis: Nvidia's moat isn't one thing — it's the whole five-layer stack (supply chain, chips, CUDA, ecosystem, install base) compounding annually. The TPU/ASIC threat is overstated, the China export-control debate is being fought on cartoon premises, and the next leg of compute scaling comes from algorithms and segmentation, not just transistors.

recent_videos.title: Jensen Huang: Nvidia's Future, Physical AI, Rise of the Agent, Inference Explosion, AI PR Crisis
recent_videos.thesis: Jensen Huang argues Nvidia has evolved from a GPU company into an AI-factory company whose moat is the full CUDA stack across every compute layer, and that agentic AI plus physical AI represent a vastly larger market than analysts model — so the industry's real risk is self-inflicted doomerism, not technology.
